name: Bojacá (Colombia)
description: Vertical bicolour of yellow and white, the yellow narrower, the white charged with the municipal arms of Bojacá (the letter B on blue, crowned).
history: Municipal flag of Bojacá, a municipality in the department of Cundinamarca, Colombia; Colombian municipal flags are adopted by agreement (acuerdo) of the municipal council or by decree of the mayor.

features.role: Bojacá arms — letter B on blue, crowned
